description: This file implements the UniqueOperator class, a custom operator for finding unique elements in a tensor within the torchfuzz framework. It includes methods for generating input specifications, code generation for unique operations, and properties describing the operator.

classes.name: UniqueOperator
classes.description: Operator for finding unique elements in a tensor.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the UniqueOperator instance and sets the operator name to 'unique'.

methods.name: str|None torch_op_name(self)
methods.description: Property that returns the torch operation name associated with this operator, which is 'torch.unique'.

methods.name: bool can_produce(self, output_spec: Spec)
methods.description: Checks if the operator can produce an output specification; specifically, if the output is a 1D tensor.

methods.name: list[Spec] fuzz_inputs_specs(self, output_spec: Spec, num_inputs: int = 1)
methods.description: Generates input specifications for the unique operation, assuming fixed tensor size and matching dtype.

methods.name: str codegen( self, output_name: str, input_names: list[str], output_spec: Spec )
methods.description: Generates the PyTorch code snippet to perform the unique operation on the input tensor, producing the specified output.

ctags.signature: ( self, output_name: str, input_names: list[str], output_spec: Spec )
